description.p: Umbra is based on Apollo, which is based on Sunshine by LizardByte. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by LizardByte or the Apollo project.

On supported Wayland desktops, approve screen sharing in your desktop's normal permission dialog. Remembered permission avoids repeating this step when the desktop supports it. Virtual Co-op Pane support depends on the desktop's display controls.
Streamed keyboard, mouse and controller input may require one administrator-approved setup: flatpak run --command=additional-install.sh @PROJECT_FQDN@. Run Umbra as your normal desktop user.
The local configuration page uses a self-signed certificate. Confirm that the address is your own streaming computer when accepting its certificate.
See the release notes on GitHub.
